bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 4, 6, 8. YANGZI RIVER was presented on debut at Kembla Grange when she needed to overcome traffic problems to score. She's trialed since and she's now more than ready to make her metropolitan debut. TANNIN begins his second campaign after a recent Rosehill trial. His unplaced Eagle Farm effort before his spell must be overlooked. There were excuses on the day. TENENBAUM was dominant first up last campaign at Wyong and he's ready to resume again after two trials. SPRITELY AFFAIR was much too good for all expect the winner second up at Hawkesbury and stepping up slightly in distance from 1100m can be coped with today. UNHINGED was a dual acceptor for this meeting with this race chosen as his best target. He begins his second campaign after trialing twice and with gear changes made. This journey should be ideal first up. LEONESSA was also a dual acceptor for this meeting. She was an early withdrawal from race two and after her solid effort here last start over this journey last start, she does have scope to improve.

raceTips.comment: The lightly raced Sprightly Affair won in dominant fashion two starts back before fighting on strongly through the line over 1100m last start, now at peak fitness this preparation and has the superior early speed in the race to find the front to dictate the tempo to suit. Yangzi River hit the line well over 1300 when winning on debut last start, would have taken considerable improvement off that run and is well suited dropping back slightly in distance. Expecting competitive first up performances from Tenenbaum & Unhinged over the suitable 1200m with in form jockeys on board both gallopers.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 7, 10, 13. AFFARI had trialed twice before she resumed within this distance range on this track last start. She performed well above market place expectations against the leader/winner on the day and she can only now present race-fitter. PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL has trialed twice since a break with Zac Lloyd aboard on both occasions. He's now ready to make a strong debut. DEFENSEMEN has not been to the races for forty-six days but he did trial earlier in the month at Randwick and he's raced well fresh before. He can do so again today! CANTERO kept trying after he struck trouble here on debut and natural improvement can now be expected. PIEDMONT refused to shirk her task in defeat here first up when she didn't finish far away from a subsequent start Warwick Farm dominant winner. PIEDMONT is another who can only now present race-fitter. LOVE STORY has trialed twice since a spell with Adam Hyeronimus aboard on both occasions. She's now more than ready to make her raceday debut.

raceTips.comment: Affari resumed well over 1200m last start when hitting the line strongly late, the filly would have taken further improvement off that performance and maps to get a soft run throughout from the inside draw. Cantero hit the line well over 1200m on debut last start at the track, strips fitter now and draws to get the run of the race stalking the leading pair in transit. Piedmont & Defensemen bring the required last start form into the race and with improvement between runs will both figure in the finish.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 3, 5, 6. CHEVAL DE BOIS was apprentice ridden when his front-running effort over this distance here last start was solid. He can be expected to at least now maintain his form with Zac Lloyd back aboard. STANDARD DEVIATION has trialed since there were excuses for his unplaced effort here first up. Unlike some, he can cope over this testing journey second up. DUBAI WARRIOR performed above market place expectations when he tackled this trip here last start. He has been kept fresh since and he did score at his previous Wyong engagement when he was presented after an identical twenty-one day break. CHAMPAGNE HERO was withdrawn from the meeting last Saturday at his Randwick home base. Instead he will attempt a suitable distance rise today with a gear change made (blinkers back on).

raceTips.comment: Cheval De Bois has shown enough ability in recent outings and looks suited by the race setup, with the map giving every chance to settle within striking distance. Cheval De Bois should be able to conserve energy early and produce a sustained finish when the pressure goes on. Fioprospero has been racing consistently and possesses the tactical speed to settle closer to the leaders. Fioprospero looks capable of getting the right run and should be strong enough late. Champagne Hero has shown glimpses of good ability and should appreciate a genuine tempo. Champagne Hero can improve with a clean passage and remains a genuine threat if he gets clear running. Supreme Sovereign has been competitive without having everything go his way. Supreme Sovereign maps for an economical run and can finish off strongly if the gaps appear at the right time.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 9, 10, 11, 12. CAFE AU LAIT presents first up after trialing twice at her Rosehill home base with James McDonald aboard on both occasions. Both first up efforts to date have been solid and another strong performance can be expected from her first up over a suitable journey today. ME ME handed in quick closing sectionals for the class to score within this distance range first up at Kembla Grange. She can already further progress today, aided by the claim for Mollie Fitzgerald. SPHERE must not be harshly judged for an unplaced second up effort in stronger class at Rosehill. She endured too tough a run on the day. OVERTOOK surprised the market place when she tackled this trip here apprentice ridden last start. She can play a part again today with Anna Roper aboard for a first time. YOU'RE THE CHOICE can cause her own problems with an awkward getaway but she can make her presence felt here, with improved barrier manners.

raceTips.comment: Jenni The Jet looks well placed to control proceedings from a favourable position and has the speed to put herself into the race early. Jenni The Jet should be able to dictate her own terms and will take plenty of running down if allowed to travel comfortably. Farfetched has been holding his form well and brings a reliable finishing effort into this assignment. Farfetched should settle within range and has the turn of foot to make his presence felt late. You're The Choice has shown enough in recent performances to suggest this company is within reach. You're The Choice can roll forward and make his own luck before being saved for one run at them. Me Me is another runner with scope to improve and should be suited if the speed is genuine. Me Me can find the line strongly and looks capable of getting into the finish.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 2, 5, 9, 11. PHANTOM MAJOR looked the part when he was produced here within this distance range at only his second start in his first campaign. Natural improvement can now be expected. KOMODO DRAGON is resuming after two home based Randwick trials. He was spelled after the lone Warwick Farm effort last campaign when after a much longer spell, he stuck to his task in defeat in a race that's produced strong form. HARRY'S EVIDENCE dug deep to prevail here first up after only the lone lead-up trial. He was making his Canterbury debit on the day and he should now have more to offer. CASTLEJOHN was beginning only his second campaign when he refused to lose at Hawkesbury. He will now make his Canterbury debut and a step up from 1100m can now be regarded as a plus.

raceTips.comment: Castlejohn has been building a solid record and looks ready to produce another competitive performance. Castlejohn should settle in a comfortable position and has enough early pace to avoid getting too far out of his ground. Phantom Major has been racing honestly and continues to give himself every chance through his consistent effort. Phantom Major can position close enough to the speed and should be strong when the pressure increases. Harrys Evidence has shown good ability and should appreciate the opportunity to settle behind the leading division. Harrys Evidence has the acceleration to make a sustained run and will be dangerous with clear running. The Little General has enough form around this level to warrant plenty of respect. The Little General should get a soft run in transit and can finish off solidly when produced at the right time.

His unplaced first up effort (when he was outclassed) last preparation must be ignored. MISS TRENTINO was resuming from a very long spell when her frontrunning effort here was honest over this journey and she can only now present race-fitter. TAXATION presents first up after three lead-up trials. Her unplaced lone effort last campaign should be forgiven when there were excuses at home (Warwick Farm). ACTION KING raced keenly before he all but scored first up at Eagle Farm. He was then dominant on the Acton track within this distance range at his Canberra home base and he does have scope to already progress.

Melanite has shown enough ability to remain in calculations and can give a good account of herself. Melanite should appreciate a genuine tempo and can work home strongly over the latter stages.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 6, 8. COBRA CLUB was produced third up at Randwick last start when his unplaced effort was better than it appears at face value. PIERRO LAD presents fourth up and in search of a hat-trick. His fourth up effort last campaign was full of merit after he endured a tough run from the widest gate at Hawkesbury. He should have less to do today from an inside barrier. PIERATA'S GEM presents fourth up in her first campaign since a stable change. Winkers were added to her gear before her unplaced latest Rosehill effort was honest and she should relish the drop in class that now awaits. THREE ARROWS combined with Tommy Berry when they were too good for all except the winner here, over this distance, last start. He can maintain his form today without causing a surprise. RILEYCAT did enough here over 1250m second up to suggest that she will greatly appreciate the distance rise that now awaits her. RED RAGS TO BULLS was kept fresh before her Newcastle win within this distance range last start and she can maintain her form when she presents fresh again today.

raceTips.comment: Cobra Club has plenty of upside and looks well suited to this assignment after showing good ability in recent runs. Cobra Club should settle in a handy position and has the tactical speed to put himself into the race before the pressure goes on. Cobra Club can sustain a strong run late and looks one of the main chances. Three Arrows has been racing consistently and continues to show a competitive attitude. Three Arrows should get a comfortable run just behind the leaders and can build momentum when the gaps appear. Pierro Lad has shown enough speed and strength to be competitive in this company. Pierro Lad can roll forward and make his own luck, which should allow him to stay within striking distance throughout.
